title: [review] OSCORE ctx-miss sends 4.01 then handler falls through to second 4.00 ACK (double response, same MID)
description: P1, confirmed independently by 2 reviewers. coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request ctx-lookup-failure path (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_oscore.c:62-65) SENDS 4.01 via coap_oscore_send_unauthorized and returns coap_err_to_oscore(...) = 0 (OSCORE_OK). Callers treating 0 as success continue: oscore.is_protected==true skips admin check, oscore.payload==NULL hits return COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_BAD_REQUEST, and the Zephyr framework auto-ACKs positive returns for CON (coap_server.c:274 in 4.1, :235 in 3.7) -> two ACKs, one MID: client sees 4.01 then 4.00 (RFC 7252 mismatch), wasted LoRa airtime. Triggered by any OSCORE request with no established ctx (normal after node reboot). Affects deaddrop_post + confessions_post (coap_dtn.c:108-112, 227-231); same latent pattern in config_put/msg_inbox_post (coap_server.c). Fix at the helper: on ctx-miss return COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_UNAUTHORIZED WITHOUT sending (mirror the unprotect-fail path at :74-79) so caller/framework produce exactly one response; then audit all callers for the new contract.
